title: Owner: restore once on the Pi from the off-host copy
goal: A real restore on the Pi proves the whole path
acceptance: The owner runs the README restore commands on the Pi from the off-host copy and the hub shows the old rooms and readings; date and result are recorded here and in the coordinator durable-data table
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: The date and result are recorded
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: One drill, 30 minutes. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
